args: Both cited statements contribute to the justification for honoring the elders.
Brotherhood is not licensed as a reason for contempt; the ground is embedded under the prohibition.
The greed statement supports the preceding warning about the desire for wealth.
The statements concerning one God and one mediator support the preceding concern for all people.
The conditional rhetorical question tests fitness for oversight; it does not assert that a particular person fails the condition.
The described outcome of good service supplies motivation for the preceding service requirements.
The benefits of godliness described in both main clauses provide motivation for obeying the training exhortation.
The comparison directs attention from limited bodily benefit to the wider benefit of godliness; contrast is contextual rather than a mandatory translation of de.
Divine acceptability is presented as a reason for the family-care instruction.
